item.title: Full Court Press February 20, 2026
item.description: Conference champions have been crowned as all eyes now focus on the high school basketball playoffs.

item.title: Church in Chadbourn closes, but still alive in spirit
item.description: A local church in Chadbourn has closed down, but before it shut down forever, the last Sunday service was filled with congregant. Now, there is a hope that something new will come out of it.

item.title: Bill Mazeroski, Baseball Hall of Famer and Pittsburgh Pirates legend, dies at 89
item.description: The man who will forever be known for hitting the greatest home run in baseball history - a game 7 walk-off in the World Series - Bill Mazeroski, has died at 89.

item.title: White House dinner closes a turbulent week for governors in Washington
item.description: The annual dinner with governors at the White House is typically a chance for leaders from both parties to come together, socialize and spend a low-key evening with the president.

item.title: Former “American Idol” contestant Caleb Flynn charged with murder, staging crime scene in wife’s death in Ohio
item.description: Authorities in Ohio have charged a former contestant on "American Idol" with shooting and killing his wife and staging the crime scene to mislead investigators.

item.title: NASA delays astronaut moon mission again after new rocket problem
item.description: In the latest setback to return astronauts to the moon, NASA delayed the highly anticipated flight yet again after a new problem cropped up with the rocket Saturday.

item.title: Court clears way for Louisiana law requiring Ten Commandments in classrooms
item.description: A U.S. appeals court has cleared the way for a Louisiana law requiring poster-sized displays of the Ten Commandments in public classrooms to take effect.

item.title: Travel back in time to 1766 at the Brunswick Town/Fort Anderson State Historic Site
item.description: Travel back in time at the Brunswick Town/Fort Anderson State Historic Site, where interpreters teach you what it was like in 1766.

item.title: WilmingtoNColor hosts second annual Black History Carnival
item.description: WilmingtonNColor hosted its second annual Black History Carnival, where people could learn about black history, and come together as a community.

item.title: Coffee Crawl, perfect way to start keep the energy high
item.description: At the Brooklyn Arts District, several businesses were part of the Coffee Crawl event. Businesses were selling a variety of coffee and espresso flavors to people walking around the district.
